product_overview: Pav Dental is a UK mobile dental clinic, flagship practice, and telehealth backend that serves public catalog data, patient account workflows, and authenticated clinical self-service APIs. The service uses Express, TypeScript, Prisma, PostgreSQL, Redis, JWT, and Zod to support patient-facing healthcare operations.
core_goals: Provide reliable health and readiness probes for infrastructure monitoring
Expose public catalog and mobile van coverage lookup endpoints
Support secure patient authentication, registration, and session lifecycle management
Enable patients to manage profiles, review odontograms, treatment plans, and document vault items
Provide booking visibility, appointment retrieval, and clinical messaging for authenticated users
Offer dental financing applications, rewards tracking, oral health insights, and brushing logs
Capture and retrieve GDPR consents with full audit history

features.name: Health and Readiness API
features.description: Public probes that verify the backend service and its dependent infrastructure are operational.
user_flows: GET /health -> Receive 200 with service status and database/redis checks marked ok -> GET /livez -> Receive 200 with service liveness status
GET /health -> Receive 503 or non-200 when a dependency is unavailable -> GET /livez -> Receive service status indicating the instance is not ready
GET /health -> Receive 200 with status ok and dsptMode active -> Confirm the API can be monitored by orchestration systems

features.name: Dental Services and Clinicians Catalog API
features.description: Publicly accessible catalog endpoints for browsing active dental services, clinicians, and clinics.
user_flows: GET /api/services -> Receive 200 with active dental services -> GET /api/services/clinicians -> Receive 200 with clinician profiles -> GET /api/services/clinics -> Receive 200 with active clinics
GET /api/services?channel=clinic -> Receive 200 with filtered services for clinic channel -> GET /api/services?channel=van -> Receive 200 with filtered services for van channel
GET /api/services?channel=invalid -> Receive 400 with validation error for unsupported channel
GET /api/services/clinicians -> Receive 200 with clinician list -> GET /api/services/clinics -> Receive 200 with clinic list despite no authentication

features.name: Public Mobile Van Coverage Check API
features.description: Public geospatial coverage lookup for determining whether a postcode or GPS coordinate is served by a mobile dental van.
user_flows: POST /api/public/van/coverage-check with valid lat and lng -> Receive 200 with isCovered, coordinates, assignedVan, message, and inputType gps
POST /api/public/van/coverage-check with valid postcode input -> Receive 200 with coverage result and normalized coordinates
POST /api/public/van/coverage-check with malformed coordinates -> Receive 400 with validation error
POST /api/public/van/coverage-check with out-of-coverage location -> Receive 200 with isCovered false and assignedVan null

features.name: Authentication and Session API
features.description: Patient account creation, login, token refresh, email availability checks, and active session listing.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/check-email with an existing email -> Receive 200 with exists true and role patient -> POST /api/auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with accessToken, refreshToken, and user

POST /api/auth/register with a unique email and valid profile details -> Receive 201 with accessToken, refreshToken, and user -> GET /api/auth/sessions with bearer accessToken -> Receive 200 with active sessions
POST /api/auth/login with invalid password -> Receive 401 with authentication error
POST /api/auth/refresh with expired or invalid refreshToken -> Receive 401 with token error
POST /api/auth/check-email with a new email -> Receive 200 with exists false -> POST /api/auth/register with the same email and strong password -> Receive 201 with newly created account

features.name: Patient Profile, Odontogram, Plans and Documents API
features.description: Authenticated patient records area for profile management, tooth chart review, treatment plans, and document vault access using the authenticated user ID as the path parameter.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with accessToken and user.id -> GET /api/patients/:id/profile with bearer token and matching user.id -> Receive 200 with patient profile -> PUT /api/patients/:id/profile with updated address and name fields -> Receive 200 with profile updated response -> GET /api/patients/:id/documents -> Receive 200 with signed download URLs

POST /api/auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with accessToken and user.id -> GET /api/patients/:id/odontogram -> Receive 200 with tooth records -> GET /api/patients/:id/plans -> Receive 200 with treatment plans
GET /api/patients/:id/profile with missing or invalid bearer token -> Receive 401 unauthorized error
PUT /api/patients/:id/profile with a path id that does not match the authenticated user -> Receive 401 or forbidden error

features.name: Booking and Appointments API
features.description: Authenticated endpoints for viewing real-time bookable slots and the user's existing appointments.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with accessToken -> GET /api/booking/slots?date=2026-10-25&channel=clinic with bearer token -> Receive 200 with available slots -> GET /api/booking/appointments -> Receive 200 with appointment list
POST /api/auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with accessToken -> GET /api/booking/slots?date=2026-10-25&channel=van with bearer token -> Receive 200 with van channel slots
GET /api/booking/slots?date=2026-10-25 without bearer token -> Receive 401 unauthorized error
GET /api/booking/slots?date=invalid-date with bearer token -> Receive 400 validation error for date format

features.name: Clinical Messaging API
features.description: Persistent patient-clinician messaging threads with thread listing and new thread creation.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with accessToken -> GET /api/messages with bearer token -> Receive 200 with seeded or existing message threads -> POST /api/messages with subject, body, and recipientName -> Receive 201 with created message thread
POST /api/messages with missing subject or body -> Receive 400 validation error
GET /api/messages without bearer token -> Receive 401 unauthorized error
POST /api/auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with accessToken -> GET /api/messages -> Receive 200 with message threads including initial clinical threads on first access

features.name: Dental Financing and BNPL API
features.description: Authenticated buy-now-pay-later financing overview and application submission for eligible dental treatment costs.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with accessToken -> GET /api/financing with bearer token -> Receive 200 with pre-approved limit, APR, and existing applications -> POST /api/financing/apply with treatmentCostPence and durationMonths -> Receive 201 with pre_approved financing application
POST /api/financing/apply with treatmentCostPence below minimum or above maximum -> Receive 400 validation error
POST /api/financing/apply with unsupported durationMonths value -> Receive 400 validation error
GET /api/financing without bearer token -> Receive 401 unauthorized error

features.name: Smile Perks and Oral Health Insights API
features.description: Authenticated rewards dashboard with points balance, reward catalog, oral health insights, and brushing log submission.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with accessToken -> GET /api/rewards with bearer token -> Receive 200 with points balance, streak, catalog, and redemptions -> GET /api/rewards/insights -> Receive 200 with oral health metrics and practitioner advice -> POST /api/rewards/brushing-log with day, session, and durationSec -> Receive 200 with updated points and brushing data
POST /api/rewards/brushing-log with durationSec below 30 or above 600 -> Receive 400 validation error
GET /api/rewards without bearer token -> Receive 401 unauthorized error
POST /api/rewards/brushing-log with invalid session value -> Receive 400 validation error

features.name: GDPR Consents API
features.description: Authenticated consent management for granting, viewing, and auditing active GDPR consent records.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with accessToken -> POST /api/consents/grant with consentType and lawfulBasis -> Receive 201 with consent record -> GET /api/consents/current -> Receive 200 with active consents -> GET /api/consents/history -> Receive 200 with consent audit history
POST /api/consents/grant with invalid consentType -> Receive 400 validation error
POST /api/consents/grant with invalid lawfulBasis -> Receive 400 validation error
GET /api/consents/current without bearer token -> Receive 401 unauthorized error
